integrity: A direct algebraic proof is accompanied by exhaustive finite-field checks for orders two, three and four; these checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite-family proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts square-one automorphisms, including the identity, for this fixed five-dimensional free nilpotent Lie algebra over all finite fields. It does not count conjugacy classes or treat general rank/class. Broader specialist literature may imply the formulas.
title: Square-one automorphisms of the free class-three Lie algebra on two generators
